For the smallest value of y, we have y = 2 (since,x0 is in indeterminate form)

Now, For 72x843124 to be divisible by 9,

the sum of its digits i.e. 7 + 2 + x + 8 + 4 + 3 + 1 + 2 + 4 = 31 + x must be divisible by 9,

For this, the value of x must be 5 i.e. 31+5=36, which is divisible by 9.

So,   xy - yx = 52 - 25 = 2110 = 2110

NumberCyclicity

III.

If expression (x2 + Px - 44) is completely divisible by (x + 11) and (x - Q), then what is the value of Q?

यदि अभिव्यक्ति (x2 + Px - 44) पूर्ण रूप से (x + 11) और (x - Q) से विभाजित होती है, तो Q का मान कितना है?
questions.s:
Since, f(x) = (x2 + Px - 44) is divisible by (x + 11).

f(-11) = 0

(-11)2 + P(-11) - 44 = 0

121 - 11P - 44 = 0

77 = 11P

P = 7

(x2 + Px - 44) = (x2 + 7x - 44)

(x2 + 11x - 4x - 44)

x(x + 11) - 4(x + 11)

(x + 11)(x - 4) is divisible by (x + 11) and (x - Q).

Hence, the value of Q is 4.

Alternate solution

-11*Q = -44(product of the roots of the equation)

Therefore Q =4

questions.q:
When a number is divided successively by 7, 16, and 19, we get the remainder of 3, 4, and 5, respectively. When the same number is divided successively by 19, 16, and 7, we get the remainder of A, B, and C, respectively. Find the value of (C + B - A).

जब किसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 7, 16 और 19 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः 3, 4 और 5 शेष प्राप्त होते हैं। जब उसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 19, 16 और 7 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः A, B और C शेष प्राप्त होते हैं। (C + B - A) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
Let in the first condition, the last quotient be 1.

So, dividend for 19 = 19 * 1 + 5 = 24

Dividend for 16 = 16 * 24 + 4 = 388

Dividend for 7 = 7 * 388 + 3 = 2719

So, the number is 2719

Now,

2719/19, Quotient = 143 and Remainder (A) = 2

143/16, Quotient = 8 and remainder (B) = 15

8/7, Quotient = 1 and remainder (C) = 1

Hence, C + B - A = 1 + 15 - 2 = 14

questions.q: 14. A two-digit number is 12 more than five times the sum of its digits. The number formed by reversing the digits is 9 less than the original number. The number is:

According to the question,
Number is 12 more than five times the sum of its digits

5x - 4y = 12-------(i)
Number formed by reversing the digits is 9 less than the original number
10y + x = 10x + y - 9
x - y = 1-------(ii)
Equation [(i) - 5 × (ii)] we get;
y = 7
Put y = 7 in equation (ii) we get;
x - 7 = 1 ⇒ x = 8

Alternate solution

-11*Q = -44(product of the roots of the equation)

Therefore Q =4

questions_hin.q_hi:
When a number is divided successively by 7, 16, and 19, we get the remainder of 3, 4, and 5, respectively. When the same number is divided successively by 19, 16, and 7, we get the remainder of A, B, and C, respectively. Find the value of (C + B - A).

जब किसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 7, 16 और 19 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः 3, 4 और 5 शेष प्राप्त होते हैं। जब उसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 19, 16 और 7 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः A, B और C शेष प्राप्त होते हैं। (C + B - A) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let in the first condition, the last quotient be 1.

So, dividend for 19 = 19 * 1 + 5 = 24

Dividend for 16 = 16 * 24 + 4 = 388

Dividend for 7 = 7 * 388 + 3 = 2719

So, the number is 2719

Now,

2719/19, Quotient = 143 and Remainder (A) = 2

143/16, Quotient = 8 and remainder (B) = 15

8/7, Quotient = 1 and remainder (C) = 1

Hence, C + B - A = 1 + 15 - 2 = 14

questions_hin.q_hi: 14. दो अंकों की एक संख्या अपने अंकों के योग के पांच गुने से 12 अधिक है। अंकों को उलटने से बनी संख्या मूल संख्या से 9 कम है। वह संख्या ______है।
questions_hin.s_hi:
14.(c)
माना संख्या = 10x + y
प्रश्न के अनुसार,
संख्या अपने अंकों के योग के पांच गुना से 12 अधिक है
10x + y = 5(x + y) + 12
5x - 4y = 12-------(i)
अंकों को उलटने से बनी संख्या मूल संख्या से 9 कम है
10y + x = 10x + y - 9
x - y = 1-------(ii)
समीकरण [(i) - 5 × (ii)] हमें मिलता है;
y = 7
समीकरण (ii) में y = 7 रखने पर हमें प्राप्त होता है;
x - 7 = 1 ⇒ x = 8
अत: संख्या = 10 × 8 + 7 = 87

questions_hin.q_hi:
When a number is divided by 512 it leaves a remainder 67. If the same number is divided by 32, then what will be the remainder?

जब किसी संख्या को 512 से विभाजित किया जाता है तो शेषफल 67 बचता है। यदि उसी संख्या को 32 से विभाजित किया जाए तो शेषफल क्या होगा?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Express the number as 512 X k + 67.

Since 512 is exactly divisible by 32

the remainder when dividing by 32 comes only from 67. Dividing 67 by 32 gives a remainder of 67 - 32 X 2 = 67 - 64 = 3.

Three numbers are in the ratio of 12: 7: 15 and their HCF is 9. What is the sum of these numbers?

Sum of ratios = 12 + 7 + 15 = 34
